run.title: Build & Run Grove
run.command: xcodebuild -project Grove.xcodeproj -scheme Grove -derivedDataPath build -destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' build && open -n build/Build/Products/Debug/Grove.app

agent_prompt: Grove is a native macOS SwiftUI app (no simulators or web runtime). Build and test with xcodebuild from app/Grove using the worktree-local -derivedDataPath build. Never perform git writes against real repositories while testing; use a scratch repo under /tmp.
